whenToUse: Edit forms and long scrolling content that slide in from a screen edge over the page
Panels pinned to the top, right, bottom or left edge, with their own footer actions

whenNotToUse.when: A touch panel the user drags or swipes closed
A ready made record detail, notification or settings panel
A short decision or form that belongs in the middle of the screen

agentNotes: `SheetContent` draws its own corner close button; set `showCloseButton` to false when the footer closes it
Top and bottom sheets grow with their content and have no height cap, so bound them as `c-sheet-3` does
`SheetTrigger` and `SheetClose` take a `render` element on the base twin and `asChild` on the radix twin
